info.name: Sigma-Aldrich Product Search Pricing and Availability API

params.name: catalogNumber
params.description: Sigma-Aldrich catalog number (e.g., A1048, M8159, CAS1234-56-7)

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for regional pricing

items.docs: Returns current pricing and real-time stock availability for all packaging sizes of a product in the specified country/region.
